title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Reading a Company's Financial Statements

questions.text: Which financial report shows a company's financial position as a snapshot of a single day, details what it owns, and lists what it owes?
questions.explanation: The balance sheet provides a snapshot of a single day, displaying a company's assets and liabilities.

questions.text: True or false: The Income Statement tracks actual physical cash entering and leaving a company's bank account.
questions.explanation: The Cash Flow Statement tracks actual physical cash movements, whereas the Income Statement measures revenue, expenses, and net profit over a period of time.
